items.briefing:
Australian edtech platform Mathspace has disclosed a data breach affecting over one million people — if your organisation uses Mathspace, or if staff or students have accounts, they should watch for phishing emails or suspicious contact using their personal details. Separately, security experts are warning that automated, AI-driven cyberattacks are expected to become significantly more capable within six months, meaning organisations need to review their defences soon.

**Practical tip:** If you or your students use Mathspace, change your password now and enable two-factor authentication if available.
